qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominates global LNG carrier membrane containment with 90-100% market share. Royalty toll of ~3-4% of vessel capex ($250M+) is low relative to catastrophic cryogenic failure risk (-163°C), creating insurmountable customer switching costs. Empirically proven by >50-70% ROIC and ~65% operating margin. Primary erosion threat is yard-backed proprietary designs (e.g. South Korea's KC-1/KC-2) which have repeatedly failed in commercial operation.
qualitative.note: Exceptional asset-light engineering monopoly on LNG carrier membrane containment (>90% market share).
